Turvallisuus- ja palveluvirkailijat Menno ja Baran etsivät laukkuvarkaita. Yhdistyneen kuningaskunnan terminaalissa tiimi rientää aikaa vastaan varmistaakseen, että juna lähtee Lontooseen ajoissa. Alankomaat 2025

programme.title: Pohjoisen valtatien pelastajat: kaaosta valtateillä!
programme.desc: Jäisillä teillä panokset ovat korkeat, kun kyseessä on kallis lasti. Jo Roger ja hänen poikansa Ole Henrik joutuvat siirtämään suolalastia kuljettavan kuorma-auton suojellen jokea saastumiselta. Björn ja tiimi laittavat henkensä alttiiksi pelastaessaan lohia. Myöhemmin Torsteinin ja Isacin on löydettävä herkkä tasapaino, jotta he saavat pelastettua kalliin, lähes uuden maitosäiliöauton tuholta. Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc! Compilation - Yhdysvallat 2023

programme.title: Jimmy Chin ja vaaran viehätys
programme.desc: Tahdonvoima. Lähestyessään uransa huipentumaa kiipeilijä Will Gadd haluaa saavuttaa sen, mitä monet pitävät mahdottomana: olla ensimmäinen, joka nousee Overhead Hazard -reitin Helmcken Fallsilla, joka on 131-metrinen jäätynyt vesiputous Kanadassa. Se tunnetaan maailman vaikeimpana reittinä maailmassa. Will pelkää turvallisuutensa puolesta, kun hän kiipeää pakkasessa ja väistelee jättimäisiä jääpuikkoja. Edge of the Unknown With Jimmy Chin - Yhdysvallat 2021

programme.title: Pompeji: Oppaana Tom Hiddleston
programme.desc: Järistykset. Vesuvius heräilee, ja Tom Hiddleston pohtii, huomaako kukaan varoitusmerkkejä ajoissa. Seuraamalla teini-ikäisen oppipojan ja mahtavan liikenaisen tarinaa hän paljastaa, kuinka elämä jatkui kaupungissa maanjäristysten voimistuessa. Aika käy vähiin, ja Tom selvittää, miksi ihmiset sivuuttivat vaaran ja sinetöivätkö ensimmäiset päätökset lopulta heidän kohtalonsa. Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston - Iso-Britannia 2025

programme.title: Tutankhamonin haudan kirous
programme.desc: 26.11.1922 Howard Carter teki kaikkien aikojen suurimman arkeologisen löydön - kuningas Tutankhamonin aarteita pursuvan haudan. Uutiset villitsivät koko maailman. Mutta kun hautaan menneet ihmiset alkoivat kuolla, tarinat "faaraon kirouksesta" levisivät. Olivatko kuolemat vain sattumia vai sanomalehtien myyntiä varten luotuja tarinoita? Voiko moderni tiede selittää totuuden legendan takana? Tut's Toxic Tomb - Iso-Britannia 2022

programme.title: Autojen ensiapu
programme.desc: Tim ja Fuzz suuntaavat Lancashiren pohjoisosiin pelastamaan harvinaisen italialaisen ikonin, joka on jätetty 25 vuodeksi lahoamaan. Janen Alfa Romeo Spider oli hänen unelma-autonsa, jonka hän osti isänsä jättämällä perinnöllä, mutta sitten julma pankkihuijaus vei häneltä kaikki säästöt. Nyt ruoste on ottanut vallan, joten pystyvätkö pojat pelastamaan auton ennen kuin aika viimein voittaa? Car SOS - Iso-Britannia 2025

programme.title: Antoni Porowski: Elämänmakuiset reseptit
programme.desc: Justin Theroux'n italialainen tehtävä. Antoni Porowski vie Justin Theroux’n matkalle Italian henkeäsalpaavan Emilia-Romagnan alueelle jahtaamaan kanoja ja keräämään simpukoita. Matkan varrella he maistelevat alueen hienoimpia ruokia ja tekevät yllättäviä paljastuksia Justinin italialaisista sukujuurista. Paljastukset auttavat selvittämään mysteerin eräästä suvun ruoasta, joka päätyi esi-isien mukana Atlantin toiselle puolelle. No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski - Yhdysvallat 2024

programme.title: Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol
programme.desc: On aika tutkia oudoimpia tapauksia ja villejä jahteja sekä nauttia joulun taiasta. Eläinlääkäri on toipumassa nilkkaleikkauksesta, kun hän ajelee skootterillaan. Kaksi kanaa kärsii paljaista takapuolista. Tri Pol on aina käytännöllinen, joten hän ehdottaa, että omistaja peittää matoilla mäntylankut, jolla kanat istuvat, jotta pihka ei tartu niiden pyrstösulkiin ja revi niitä irti. Helppo homma. The Incredible Dr. Pol - Yhdysvallat 2019

programme.title: Lentoturmatutkinta
programme.desc: Yksitoista vaaran sekuntia. China Airlinesin lento 676 sammuu pahenevan sähkömyrskyn aikana koneen lähestyessä Taipeita. Kone putoaa suoraan kiireiselle tielle. Onnettomuudessa kuolevat kaikki 196 ihmistä koneessa ja kuusi henkilöä maassa. Kyseessä on maan historian hirvittävin lento-onnettomuus. Kaikki oli kiinni 11 hämmentävästä sekunnista, kun kumpikaan lentäjä ei hallinnut konetta. Air Crash Investigation - Kanada 2023

programme.title: Meret ilman vettä
programme.desc: Egyptin kadonneet ihmeet. Muinaiset egyptiläiset loivat yhden maailman uskomattomimmista sivilisaatioista. Tiede ja tietokonegrafiikka voivat yhdessä tyhjentää Egyptin vedestä ja hiekasta. Drain the Oceans - Iso-Britannia 2018

programme.title: Meret ilman vettä
programme.desc: Meksikonlahti. Meksikonlahden tyhjentäminen näyttää, että Amerikan tarinan voi nähdä katsomalla mitä aaltojen alta paljastuu kaupankäynnistä, orjuudesta ja sodista. Drain the Oceans - Iso-Britannia 2018

programme.title: Oppikirjana katastrofi
programme.desc: Atomienergia. Ydinenergia voi tuottaa kaupungeille sähköä ilman hiilidioksidipäästöjä, mutta riskit ovat vahvoina yleisön muistissa. Kyseessä on kuitenkin yksi turvallisimmista energianlähteistä, ja sitä tukevat Tšernobylin, Fukushiman ja Three Mile Islandin tuomat opit. Nämä epäonnistumiset ohjaavat insinöörejä kohti turvallisempaa tulevaisuutta ja ydinfuusion tavoittelua. Engineering by Catastrophe - Kanada 2025

programme.title: Katastrofitutkinta
programme.desc: Titan-ohjus, Estonia, Piper Alpha. Kolme katastrofia, jotka on analysoitu ja luotu uudelleen yksityiskohtaisesti asiantuntijoiden analyysin ja todisteiden avulla. Miten Titan II -ydinohjus räjähti Arkansasin siilossaan? Mikä virhe teki Estonia-aluksen uppoamisesta Euroopan pahimman merionnettomuuden sitten Titanicin? Räjähdys Piper Alphalla on historian tappavin onnettomuus öljynporauslautalla. Mikä aiheutti lautan räjähdyksen? Disaster Autopsy - Yhdysvallat 2023

programme.title: Richard Hammondin autopaja
programme.desc: Richard ja tiimi yrittävät saada entisöintitöitä ilmoittamalla yhden autoistaan Yhdistyneen kuningaskunnan arvostetuimpaan klassikkoautojen näyttelykilpailuun, Concours of Eleganceen. Richard Hammond's Workshop - Iso-Britannia 2021

programme.title: Suurten pyramidien kadonneet haudat
programme.desc: Pyramidien varjossa huippuarkeologien ryhmä aloittaa hämmästyttävät kaivaukset. Voisiko tämä salainen sijainti paljastaa aivan uusia todisteita nämä majesteettiset monumentit rakentaneista faaraoista? Voisiko faarao Khafren nimellä koristettu kivi ratkaista erään arkeologian suuren mysteerin eli sen, mitä tapahtui pyramideja rakennuttaneiden faaraoiden ruumiille. Lost Tombs of the Pyramids - Iso-Britannia 2020

programme.title: Lentoturmatutkinta
programme.desc: Sokkolaskeutuminen. Vuonna 2005 TANS Perun lento 204 syöksyi Amazonin sademetsään. Turma jätti jälkeensä ripoteltujen ruumiiden vanan viidakkoon. Air Crash Investigation - Kanada 2011

programme.title: Megamyrskyt
programme.desc: Australian maastopalot. Maastopalot kuuluvat elämään Australiassa, mutta kesällä 2019 maa on kuivempi ja kuumempi kuin koskaan. ”Mustaksi kesäksi” kutsutun kauden aikana palaa 24 miljoonaa hehtaaria maata. Palomiehet David ja Matt kohtaavat aivan uudenlaisen tulipalon, 19-vuotias India taistelee kotinsa pelastamiseksi ja Australian laivasto toteuttaa ennennäkemättömän evakuoinnin. programme.title: Pohjoisen valtatien pelastajat
programme.desc: Ainoa reitti. Jo Rogeriin kohdistuu kovat paineet, kun onnettomuuteen joutunut rekka tukkii pohjoisen ja etelän välillä kulkevan päätien. Vaihtoehtoisia reittejä ei ole, joten onnettomuus jakaa Norjan kahtia. Yöksi pysäköity rekka lähtee liukumaan etelässä peilijäällä. Pelastustöiden aikana Thord tajuaa kuljettajan pelastuneen onnekkaasti, sillä rekka oli vähällä syöksyä jyrkkää rinnettä alas. Ice Road Rescue - Norja 2026

programme.title: Suuret rakenteet: rakennustekniikan ihmeitä
programme.desc: Jättimäinen autotehdas. Saksan Wolfsburgin autotehdas on maailman suurin tuotantolaitos, ja se kattaa yli kuusi neliökilometriä. Tehdas toimii kuin pieni kaupunki. Suomi 2026

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Mikko, Rene ja Sauli-koira hälytetään Nuuksioon nuotiopaikalle etsimään huumeita. Nainen huutaa kadulla poliisia apuun keskellä yötä, ja vähäpukeinen mies masturboi julkisella paikalla.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Moottoripyöräpoliisit Nico ja Markku saavat kiinni useammankin vaarallisesti ajavan kuljettajan. Kolme nuorta on yrittänyt ryöstää miehen väkivalloin. Kuinka monta poliisia tarvitaan vaihtamaan auton lamppu?

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Ratsupoliisit partioivat Kalliossa ja Flow-festivaalin jälkitunnelmissa. Huijari on vienyt pojilta älypuhelimia klassisen tempun avulla. Hevosenlanta herättää kysymyksiä ja närkästystä kansalaisissa.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Olli ja Miika saavat ilmoituksen tiellä hyppivästä hipistä - mistä oikein on kyse? Kerrostaloasunnossa suoritetaan kotietsintä huumeviljelmän varalta. Ilmoitus tappelusta paljastuukin mutkikkaammaksi tapaukseksi.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Sebastian ja Anders ojentavat nuoria päiväkodin pihalla. Mies kiittää sakoista oikein kädestä pitäen. Loppuyöstä poliisien mielenkiinnon herättää epäilyttävä auto, josta jääkin isompi kala haaviin.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Lasse ja Fredrik hälytetään tutkimaan saunan tulipaloa. Kaksi miestä pyrkii väkivalloin juhliin, joihin he eivät ole tervetulleita. Päihtynyt nuori kertoo poliiseille syvästä ahdistuksestaan.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Tomas ja Eero ottavat mittaa toisistaan viheriöllä. Miksi mies on tehnyt itselleen vuoteen bussipysäkille? Loppuyöstä partion auto täyttyy pidätetyistä rattijuopoista.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Mikko, Rene ja Sauli-koira partioivat lämpimässä suviyössä. Tuhopolttoyritykset eri puolilla kaupunkia vaativat nopeaa toimintaa, mutta kuuman ajojahdin tuoksinnassa ehditään myös nauttia nokipannukahvit.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Olli ja Miika joutuvat toimittamaan suruviestin löydetyn vainajan omaisille. Yön aikana etsitään itsetuhoisia henkilöitä kahteenkin otteeseen. Ilokseen partio pääsee viimein jakamaan tikkarin skootterikuskille.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Asuntoon tunkeutuja saa useamman poliisipartion paikalle. Poikajoukko on pahoinpidellyt väkeä nuorten joukkokokoontumisessa. Mikko, Rene ja Sauli etsivät äitiään samurai-miekalla uhannut miestä.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Ohituskaistalle pysähtynyt henkilöauto ihmetyttää Jannea ja Tomia. Nuori teinipoika hölmöilee trukin puikoissa humalassa. Aamun sarastaessa epäilyttävä auto herättää partion huomion.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021
programme.desc: Taiteiden yö sujuu vaihtelevissa merkeissä. Sebastian ja Anders etsivät auton alle jäänyttä kissaa, ja pikaruokaravintolasta löytyy pieni hylätty koira. Aamuyöstä rasistinen huutelija menettää puhelimensa.

programme.title: Poliisit 2021

programme.title: Poliisit 2021

programme.title: Sniper 2
programme.desc: On one last mission, Thomas Beckett is sent into a remote, war-torn wasteland between Eastern Europe and Western Asia to assassinate a repressive terrorist leader. Once the mission is accomplished, Beckett and his spotter, Cole, find escaping more difficult than anticipated. In order to save their lives, Beckett and Cole must weave their way through burnt-out cities and desolate landscapes.

programme.title: Sniper 3
programme.desc: Master Gunnery Sergeant Thomas Beckett has over seventy confirmed kills in his long and illustrious career. The US Marine Corps most decorated sniper has taken out warlords, drug lords, assassins and bitter foes. This time, he's going after a friend.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: One hundred years after their ship was deliberately wrecked, the ghosts of the murdered seaman have returned to Antonio Bay to exact a ghastly vengeance.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: An engrossing suspense thriller based on actual events, THUNDERHEART stars Val Kilmer as an FBI agent with Sioux indian ancestry who is sent to a South Dakota indian reservation to capture a radical native American protester. As Kilmer struggles to get in touch with his own heritage, he begins to discover that the U.S. government has framed an innocent man.

programme.title: Snake In The Eagle's Shadow
programme.desc: SNAKE IN THE EAGLE'S SHADOW is the kung fu comedy masterpiece starring superstar Jackie Chan (RUSH HOUR, SHANGHAI NOON).

programme.title: Sinbad And The Eye Of The Tiger
programme.desc: The most ambitious of Ray Harryhausen's fabled Sinbad trilogy. When an evil sorceress turns a handsome prince into a baboon, Sinbad (Patrick Wayne) sets sail on a dangerous quest to break the witch'sspell. Co-starring Jane Seymour.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Deep-sea divers vie with a Haitian drug dealer to recover a trunkload of sunken morphine. Based on Peter Benchley's best-selling novel.

programme.title: The Man Who Would Be King
programme.desc: John Huston directed this classic Kipling adventure about British soldiers trying to bamboozle high priests in remote Kafiristan.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon is a timeless story that takes place in feudal China when miracles were credible and spirits and gods were present in man's world. It is not unbelievable that zen warriors float through the air, skim the water and battle in trees and on rooftops. Pain, revenge and duty are the stuff that bind us in this world and are the main plot line of the movie, but in the afterlife love and faith linger on.

programme.title: Lawrence Of Arabia
programme.desc: Winner of seven Academy Awards(r), including Best Picture (1962), this is the restored director's cut of the breathtaking masterpiece.

programme.title: Berry Gordy's The Last Dragon
programme.desc: Martial arts student, Leroy Green (Taimak), is on a quest to obtain the elusive all-powerful force known as "The Glow." Along the way, he must battle the evil, self-proclaimed Shogun of Harlem - a kung-fu warrior also known as Sho'nuff (Julius J. Carry III) - and rescue a beautiful singer (Prince protegee, Vanity) from an obsessed record promoter.

programme.title: Superfly
programme.desc: Superfly -the film that helped define a genre in its characters, look, sound, and feel -is reimagined with Director X, director of legendary music videos (Drake, Rihanna), introducing it to a new generation. The screenplay is by Alex Tse.

programme.title: Superfly
programme.desc: Superfly -the film that helped define a genre in its characters, look, sound, and feel -is reimagined with Director X, director of legendary music videos (Drake, Rihanna), introducing it to a new generation. The screenplay is by Alex Tse.

programme.title: Dirty (2006)
programme.desc: Hard-edged story of a gangbanger turned cop who is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue all in the course of one day.

programme.title: The Shepherd (2008)
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this hard-hitting action thriller about a border patrol agent who attempts to take down a rogue American Special Forces unit that's smuggling Afghan heroin into the United States.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: KUNG FU HUSTLE perfectly blends original comedy and explosive martial arts action. Creative and imaginative characters slam together in a comic blend of Quentin Tarantino meets Jackie Chan in a filmthat goes beyond the limits of mere comedy.

programme.title: Robin and Marian
programme.desc: Sean Connery and Audrey Hepburn star as the legendary lovers Robin Hood and Maid Marion, who reunite twenty years after their first meeting. Now the mother superior of a nunnery, Marion finds herselfdrawn to a somewhat less agile Robin Hood when he returns from a lengthy Crusade in the Holy Lands.

programme.title: Sheena (1984)
programme.desc: Exotic Tanya Roberts stars as Sheena, a comic book legend that comes to life. As a child, she was lost in the African jungle and adopted by the Zambouli tribe. She rules over the untamed wilds of Africa, until outsiders challenge her domain in this exotic action-adventure.

programme.title: Suspect (1987)
programme.desc: This tension-filled courtroom drama opens with the suicide of a Supreme Court justice. Then the young Justice Department employee to whom he had given privileged information is discovered dead. A deaf-mute Vietnam veteran is charged with her murder and Cher, a public defender, is appointed counsel.

programme.title: Gloria (1980)
programme.desc: Rowlands garnered an Oscar nomination for her fierce portrayal as an ex-mob mistress who takes care of a young boy after his family is wiped out by the Mafia. Gloria must rely on all her street-savvy to prevent both herself and the boy from being the mobster's next target.

programme.title: And Justice For All
programme.desc: Al Pacino portrays a hot-shot lawyer looking for justice in a justice system run amok.

programme.title: Against All Odds (1984)
programme.desc: A dangerous love triangle develops when a shady nightclub owner hires an ex-football player to findhis runaway girlfriend.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon is a timeless story that takes place in feudal China when miracles were credible and spirits and gods were present in man's world. It is not unbelievable that zen warriors float through the air, skim the water and battle in trees and on rooftops. Pain, revenge and duty are the stuff that bind us in this world and are the main plot line of the movie, but in the afterlife love and faith linger on.

programme.title: Priest (2011)
programme.desc: A vampire western about a warrior priest who disobeys church law by teaming with a young sheriff and a priestess to track down a band of renegade vampires who have kidnapped his niece. An adaptation of the action-horror TokyoPop comic book.

programme.title: See no Evil, Hear no Evil
programme.desc: One of the looniest pictures to come along in some time! STIR CRAZY teams two of the most brilliant and zany comic performers today: Richard Pryor and Gene Wilder. Skip (Wilder) and Harry (Pryor) have both been fired from their jobs, so they take off in their van for California to seek fame and fortune, but somewhere along the way the van conks out and they're broke and...well, they have to eat, right? So they land a gig as singing and dancing woodpeckers to promote a bank opening. When two bank robbers steal their costumes and stick up the bank, guess who gets the blame? Skip and Harry are carted off to the state pen for 125 years. They try to keep their sanity and their lives amidst: a sadistic warden, a hulking mass-murderer and an inter-prison rodeo - all with great hilarity.

programme.title: Seems Like Old Times
programme.desc: In Neil Simon's SEEMS LIKE OLD TIMES, Chevy Chase is forced to abet some bank robbers, and soon the cops are after him. His ex-wife, Goldie Hawn, is a liberal lawyer married to the local district attorney. When Chase arrives at their home seeking shelter, she takes him in and their passions are rekindled.

programme.title: Ishtar
programme.desc: With a song in their hearts, the CIA on their backs, a gorgeous revolutionary in their arms and two nations after their heads, Warren Beatty and Dustin Hoffman find adventure, romance and comedy on the road to ISHTAR. Isabelle Adjani is the female lead and Elaine May is the writer and director.

programme.title: Another You
programme.desc: ANOTHER YOU is the uproarious slapstick comedy about a pathological liar who, upon his release from a mental clinic, becomes involved with a con man and ends up impersonating a billionaire. Scam follows double-scam in classic Pryor/Wilder style. Features Academy Award winner Mercedes Ruehl as a con who falls for Gene Wilder.

programme.desc: After Jane finds her crying in a restaurant bathroom, Leela Penjore reveals that she is trying to avoid a pair of bodyguards sent to make sure she goes through with her marriage to Prince Sanjay of Bhutan. programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. In the course of her work Joy frequently makes enemies, and one of these is probably the killer. Buck Willis, the radio station's helicopter pilot, hates Joy because she is more successful than he is. Sabrina flies with him doing the "air report," and finds him to be a man capable of violence. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his "family" in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in "Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in "The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper," guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on "Charlie's Angels." The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious "demonstration" of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' "Hermosa Cup" tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents" leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in "Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in "The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper," guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on "Charlie's Angels." The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious "demonstration" of his talent. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' "Hermosa Cup" tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents" leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his "family" in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. programme.title: Kartalla Risto Huvilan kanssa
programme.desc: Mannerheim-hetket Suomen historiassa. Pääministeri Matti Vanhasen valtiosihteeri Risto Volanen on tehnyt merkittävän kulttuuriteon paketoimalla Suomen historian kohtalonhetket 730-sivuiseksi arvoteokseksi.

programme.title: Seitsemän ihmettä Jerusalemissa
programme.desc: Golgata: uudestisyntymisen ihme. Wilk van de Kamp ihmettelee, miksi roomalainen sotilas lävisti Jeesuksen kyljen keihällä, vaikka hän näki Jeesuksen jo kuolleen. Vaikuttavan vierailun jälkeen Vanhan Jerusalemin hautapuutarhassa ja yllättävän löydön Öljymäellä hän lähtee Jerusalemista ja menee Galileanjärven eteläisimpään kohtaan. Paikassa, jossa Jordanjoki alkaa merestä, on kastepaikka nimeltä Yardenit. Satoja ihmisiä ympäri maailmaa kastetaan täällä joka päivä. Juuri tässä kauniissa paikassa Wilk haluaa näyttää sinulle, että Jumala näkee sinut ristin ihmeen kautta: sinua halutaan, pyydetään ja rakastetaan syvästi.

programme.title: Kujalla
programme.desc: Virkakäsitys helluntailaisin ja luterilaisin silmin. Teologi Soili Haverinen Suomen teologisesta instituutista (STI) ja Samuel Tedder, Turun helluntaiseurakunnan johtava pastori pohtivat, mikä on naisten rooli seurakunnassa, kun puhutaan johtamisesta ja opettamisesta? Miten helluntailiikkeessä ja luterilaisessa teologiassa nähdään pastorin tehtävä? Minkälaisissa tehtävissä naiset ovat palvelleet näiden yhteisöjen eri vaiheissa? Miten käsitykset ovat muuttuneet ja missä ne ovat pysyneet samoina? Mistä asioista ollaan samaa mieltä ja missä erovaisuudet näkyvät?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad

programme.title: Meg 2: The Trench
programme.desc: Sukella vieraisiin vesiin Jason Stathamin ja toimintatähti Wu Jingin kanssa heidän johtaessaan tutkimusryhmää vaarallisella tutkimusmatkalla valtameren syvyyksiin. Heidän työnsä saa kaoottisen käänteen, kun rikollinen kaivosoperaatio uhkaa heidän tehtäväänsä ja pakottaa heidät taisteluun, jossa pelissä ovat elämä ja kuolema. Kun vastassa on kolossaalisia jättiläishaita ja uhkaavia ympäristöhaasteita, sankariemme on oltava nopeampia, fiksumpia ja urheampia uimareita kuin heidän armottomat vastustajansa kellon tikittäessä vääjäämättömästi kohti ratkaisua.

programme.desc: Vieraina kirjailija, runoilija ja palkittu sanoittaja Anna-Mari Kaskinen sekä jonglööri Sofia Motturi. ADHD:sta ja normaaliuden rajoista kertoo Henri Hyppönen. Juontaja Ilkka Lahti.

programme.title: Yle Nyheter TV-nytt 19.30
programme.desc: Viimeisimmät uutiset, uutisanalyysit ja reportaasit ruotsinkieliseltä rannikkoseudulta, muualta Suomesta ja maailmalta.

programme.title: MOT
programme.desc: Rahaton yksinhuoltaja rakastui talousrikolliseen ja keräsi miljoonaomaisuuden. Luksuselämä päättyi kuitenkin vangitsemiseen kesken lomamatkan. Alkoi vuosien oikeustaisto sen selvittämiseksi, kenelle miljoonat lopulta kuuluvat. MOT tutki yhtä viime vuosien erikoisimmista oikeusjutuista.

programme.title: Maija Isola
programme.desc: Dokumenttielokuva Marimekon rakastetuimpien kankaiden suunnittelijasta Maija Isolasta. Hänen tunnetuimpia mallejaan ovat mm. Unikko, Kivet ja Melooni.O: Leena Kilpeläinen (2021) Kuvailutulkattu (U)

programme.title: Outo historia
programme.desc: 3/8. Pieni pala kuningatarta. Mitä Kaarina Maununtyttären sarkofagista paljastuu? Millaisia ruumiinosia löytyy Turun tuomiokirkon seinien sisältä? Olivatko piispa Henrik ja Lalli sittenkin olemassa?

programme.title: Suomen tie Natoon
programme.desc: Dokumenttielokuva siitä, miten mahdottomana pidetystä Nato-jäsenyydestä tuli muutamassa kuukaudessa kansallinen itsestäänselvyys. Haastateltavina mm. Niinistö, Marin ja Stoltenberg.

programme.title: Suomen tie Natoon
programme.desc: Dokumenttielokuva siitä, miten mahdottomana pidetystä Nato-jäsenyydestä tuli muutamassa kuukaudessa kansallinen itsestäänselvyys. Haastateltavina mm. Niinistö, Marin ja Stoltenberg.

programme.title: Puoli seitsemän
programme.desc: Perjantai pinkillä sohvalla: avaruustekniikan professori Jaan Praks, artisti Mirella, Miljoonasade-bändi muusikko Heikki Salon johdolla ja juontaja, yrittäjä Shirly Karvinen.

programme.title: Kirkkovieras
programme.desc: Kirkkovieras, muusikko Virpi Kätkä, pastori Aaro Rytkönen ja juontaja Elina Vaittinen keskustelevat siitä, miksi Virpi päätti opiskella teologiaa ja mitä on olla hengellisesti hereillä. Vocale-kuoro musisoi.

programme.title: Nuoret kilvoittelijat
programme.desc: 4/5. Kyynelsilmäinen Vladimiros jättää hyvästit seurakunnalleen. Frida liittyy ortodoksiseen kirkkoon ja saa mirhavoitelun päästä varpaisiin. Loviisan vasemmassa nimettömässä kimaltelee sormus. Kissoja ja koiria siunataan pyhällä vedellä.

programme.title: Säpinää susirajalla

programme.title: Vintage-valtakunta
programme.desc: Kunnostettu "Letukka" kuin suoraan Mad Max -elokuvasta, saa Tompan ja Miken haukkomaan henkeään. Kummastusta herättää myös keräilijältä löytyvä ampumapeli, joka rikkoo kaikkia sovinnaisuuden rajoja. (2017)(U) S01E03

programme.title: Meidän maamme - Vårt land: Helsinki
programme.desc: 8/10. Miltä Helsinki näyttää ilmasta kuvattuna paahteessa ja pyryssä. Jaksossa esitellään Suomen merellinen pääkaupunki Helsinki talvisessa asussaan. Suomalainen slow-tv-ohjelmasarja. (U)

programme.title: Jumppahetki
programme.desc: Jumpassa keskitytään ylävartaloon palloa apuna käyttäen.

programme.title: Taas tyttö kadoksissa
programme.desc: Reportteri Takola tutkii kadonneen Annikki Niemen tapausta. Annikki on ollut kauppias Mattilan palveluksessa ja korjaamosta löytyy Annikin polkupyörä ja päähine. Missä on Annikki, ja mitä ovat Mattilan liiketoimet? O: Ville Salminen. N: Heikki Savolainen, Pia Hattara, Santeri Karilo, Leo Jokela. (1957) (Mv) (U)

programme.title: Seitsemäs taivas
programme.desc: Viikon vieras Hannu Raittila Maarit Tastulan haastateltavana.

programme.title: Daphnen vanavedessä
programme.desc: Lasse Pöysti ja Ralf Långbacka purjehtivat Kreikan saaristossa purjelaiva Daphnen reittiä seuraillen. Matkalla he palauttavat mieleensä Göran Schildtin ajatuksia ja tapaavat hänet Leroksessa. (2000)(U)

programme.title: Nimipäiväonnittelu: 17.11.
programme.desc: Onnea, Eino ja Einari!

programme.title: Askarrellaan
programme.desc: Vilja askartelee Ainon suunnitteleman leijonan.

programme.title: Elävä arkisto: Maakalla
programme.desc: Perämerellä noin 16 kilometrin päässä Kalajoen kaupungin rantaviivasta sijaitsee kaksi saarta, joita hallitsevat kalastajat. Ruotsin kuninkaan v. 1771 säätämän lain mukaan Kallankarien asioista päättää karikokous. (2008)

programme.title: Äidiltä tyttärelle
programme.desc: Lindalla havaittiin rintasyöpä, kun hän oli 35-vuotias. Kolmen sukupolven naiset keskustelevat naisellisuudesta, naisellisesta ulkomuodosta sekä siitä, miksi niillä on väliä sairaanakin. (U) S02E03

programme.title: Muistojeni Karjala
programme.desc: 7/10. Takaisin Karjalaan. Ensimmäisiä paluumuuttajia odotti kotiseudulla tuhottu maisema. Oman kodin näkeminen, vaikka jäljellä olivat vain rauniot, oli kuitenkin monen mielestä elämän ihanin hetki. (2004) (U)

programme.title: Ruma Suomi
programme.desc: 1/8. Viipuri on kauniimpi kuin Turku. Historia elää venäläisen Viipurin kaduilla - toisin kuin Turussa. Miksi Suomi sairastui Turun tautiin? (2009)(U)

programme.title: Akuutti: Pysähtynyt sydän
programme.desc: Juuso Ruohosen sydän pysähtyi nukkuessa. Yli 30 minuutin elvytys toi lisänimen Ihme-Juuso, mutta vei äänen. Jere Hämäläisen lapsuuspelko sairaudesta kävi toteen geenivirheen myötä, ja nyt rinnassa sykkii vieras sydän.

programme.title: A-studio
programme.desc: Millaisia vaikutuksia Nvidian toimitusjohtajan yllättävällä erolla on tekoälybuumin tulevaisuuteen ja maailman talouteen? Juontajana Sakari Sirkkanen.

programme.title: Efter Nio
programme.desc: Benjamin Ingrosso soittaa erikoisia soittimia, Julia Kuokkanen Neuvostokuplastaan, Emma Frans tekoälystä ja aivomädästä, Sami Kieksi vaikeasta lapsuudestaan, Katja Bargum hämähäkeistä. Parad Media.

programme.title: Raid
programme.desc: 11/12. Kasetin sisältö paljastuu koko Suomen kansalle. Perse-Arskalta saadun kasetin sisältö selviää Raidille ja Tarjalle. Hammar kiristää Hallvikia ja ajaa etuaan kylmäverisesti. (2000)(U)

programme.title: SuomiLOVE
programme.desc: jaksossa juonivat pesis- ja bändikaverit. Luokkakokoukseen saapuu kuokkavieras ja kierros Hangossa saa unohtumattomia käänteitä. Yllätyksissä mukana mm. Suvi Teräsniska, Juha Tapio, Kasmir ja Frederik. (U) S06E02
